sourceFacts.fact: Insulin deficiency in type1 diabetes causes hyperglycaemia.
Urinary glucose promotes water loss, contributing to polyuria and thirst.

Node1 and2 are small paper tiles at left; node3 is a large visibly rectangular tray labelled Glucose and water lost in urine with a mixture of golden hexagon glucose tokens and blue water droplet tokens moving together outward across its right edge; node4 and5 are stacked to the right linked downward.
